bake.facingConvention: facing k = heading 45*k degrees counter-clockwise from screen-right (+x); +y is screen-up (away from viewer)
bake.anchorConvention: (ax, ay) = pixel inside the frame rect (origin top-left) where the ground-contact centre (model origin) sits
bake.outline: 1px ink #0E1226 baked on bots and enemies
bake.lighting: neutral dusk rig for units; sector rigs for environment
